label.administrable_evidence: This opportunity will support existing or the creation of new law enforcement agency intellectual property (IP) enforcement task forces.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity focuses on intellectual property enforcement and does not directly relate to any of the health and social service objectives in the DHHS strategic plan.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not align with any of the DMVA strategic plan goals or objectives, as it pertains to intellectual property enforcement rather than veteran services or military affairs.
